title: Tourism BC source artwork from the 2013 asset-transfer order and December 2005 standards

sources.title: Ministerial Order M068/2013: Transfer to Destination BC Corp. Regulation
BC Gazette Part II, Volume 56 Number 5, B.C. Reg. 135/2013
sources.sourceType: Official Gazette HTML and linked original image files
sources.notes: The GIFs are preserved without byte changes. Source-image URLs were obtained from the official HTML img elements.

sources.title: Tourism British Columbia Graphic Standards Manual, December 2005 (10-page excerpt)
sources.sourceType: Tourism BC manual preserved by a third-party industry host

notes: The 2013 order documents listed assets and specimens; it does not establish each design's creation date.
Canadian trademark rows and official-mark rows can describe the same design. Registration references are transcribed historical evidence, not a current legal-status check.
The 2005 manual identifies Thesis Sans and specifies PMS Black, 130, 347, 349 and 285 for the illustrated colour variants.
Original rights remain with the relevant owners; provenance in a transfer schedule does not establish an open reuse licence.
